labelling_rule: Human labels (EDG-147), written from the player's words and the contract, never from the heuristic output. kinds: the unsupported classifier kinds the declared action needs a ruling for. A catalog spell is supported only when the engine resolves it: its English name is in the declaration AND the character has access (otherwise it is unsupported). Idioms and figurative uses ('take advantage of', 'cast my net', 'rage against the machine', 'block the door', 'kill time') declare no mechanic: kinds []. 'stun' claims a stunned condition (kind condition). lethality: only the intent the player declares in their own words for an attack in combat ('lethal' | 'nonlethal'); null when none, and for non-attacks. flag 'ambiguous' rows are kept but excluded from counts. Labels changed after the first baseline are marked with label_note and are contract facts (cast access, English-name rule, stun-as-condition), not heuristic outputs.
